title: Weak-* convergence of gradients of uniformly convergent, uniformly Lipschitz functions on an open set of ℝⁿ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, C ≥ 0, and let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ and u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) all be C-Lipschitz on Ω, with u_k → u uniformly on Ω. Then for every c : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ which is Lebesgue integrable on Ω, ∫_Ω Du_k(w)(c(w)) dw → ∫_Ω Du(w)(c(w)) dw as k → ∞, where Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w (the Fréchet derivative where it exists, 0 otherwise; by Rademacher's theorem it exists at a.e. point of Ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (C : ℝ≥0) (u : Eucl n → ℝ) (ug : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C u Ω → (∀ k, LipschitzOnWith C (ug k) Ω) → TendstoUniformlyOn ug u atTop Ω → ∀ c : Eucl n → Eucl n, IntegrableOn c Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ (ug k) w (c w)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ u w (c w)))
